english:
Rear Guards
attack
from behind the
party.
The Vanguard
protects
them from enemy
attacks,
but their
attacks deal
half damage.
If every
Vanguard
Digimon is
defeated, the
Rear Guards
move up to
the Vanguard.
You must put a
Digimon
in the Vanguard
before
you can fill
the Rear
Guard, so keep
that in
mind.
